messages:
rkumar: Drafting a routing + isolation governance proposal for Q3–Q4. Aim: phased enforcement so customers can opt-in and we can measure regressions. Posting the sketch below; would love focused feedback on launch gates and migration risk.
maria: nice — can you call out the exact launch criteria? we need something SLO/testable for product.
rkumar: agreed. proposing gates: (1) pilot tenants (5 customers, <1% traffic), (2) ops runbook validated under simulated surge, (3) telemetry: p99 latency delta < 25ms and error rate <0.05%, (4) cost delta per token <10% or rollback allowed.
sam: customer ask: large-tenant wants dedicated routing lane for regulatory reasons. will that map to a dedicated slice or policy tag?
rkumar: yes — two options: tenant slice (isolated infra) or soft-isolation (route policy + affinity). slices give stronger guarantees but longer lead time and more cost.
anita: for migration we should support a soft-deploy mode that shadows traffic then gradual shift. propose 4-step: shadow -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. also include a timed automatic rollback if metrics cross thresholds.
oliver: need to add telemetry + anomaly gates: synthetic checker, user-facing error budget, and a quality regression alert tied to eval prompts. otherwise we risk silent regressions.
rkumar: agree. adding a 'quality regression' gate: for a canonical prompt set, metric delta threshold (e.g., top-k precision drop) triggers block + paged alert to SRE/product.
maria: can we codify policies? e.g.
```yaml
routing_policy:
  id: tenant-pref-1
  match: tenant_id in ["acct-123", "acct-456"]
  target: slice-redwood-s1
  fallback: shared-legacy
  canary: true
```
This helps ops automation and makes rollout deterministic.
sam: timeline question: when can we offer soft-isolation to enterprise customers? we have 3 queued asks with compliance needs.
rkumar: target Q3 pilot for soft-isolation; Q4 for slice-based isolation if pilot looks good. depends on infra capacity, SRE runbook completion, and a small migration window from customers.
anita: also need a rollback playbook + cost-accounting steps. who owns cost model for slices?
oliver: product + finance should own cost profiling; eng-infra to expose per-route token/cost breakdown and a tooling page in Console.
rkumar: next steps: I'll turn this thread into a spec doc and post link. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with gates or leave a short note with objection. planning to cut a PR for the policy DSL by EOD Friday.
ops-bot: scheduled a follow-up sync on 1733336600 (calendar invite sent).
maria: :thumbsup:
sam: +1 on soft-deploy path, suggest adding a "customer rollback window" clause to contracts.
anita: leaving a note about SRE runbook owners. tagging @ops-bot to track.
oliver: I'll add the synthetic probes and eval set to the spec after you post the doc.
rkumar: thanks all — I'll publish the draft spec in this channel in ~2 hours and include a short decision matrix (pilot criteria / stop conditions / owner list).
